# Imports
import yaml
from IPython.display import display, Markdown, HTML
from os import path

import sys
sys.path.append(path.abspath(path.join('..', '..', '..')))
import utils.helpers as h

project_yaml = path.join('..', 'items.yaml')
with open(project_yaml) as f:
    items = yaml.safe_load(f)
    details = [item for item in items if item['id']=='inky_escape'][0]
    display(HTML(h.portfolio_item_details(details)))

## About

> Escape the test rooms by painting the walls... and swimming through them! 

A game designed for **NYU Game Design 2024 - Week 5: Resource Systems**.


### Teammates & Roles

- <u>Ryan Kim (me)</u> - Level Design, Player Movement, Interactables, Ink Painting Mechanism
- <u>Zhuohang Zhuang</u> - Ink Reservoir System, Ink Shooting Mechanism, Interactables
- <u>Matthew Ma</u> - User Interface, QOL changes, Sound Assets, Debugging


## Details

### How to Play

- Move - A and D
- Jump - Space
- Mouse LMB - Shoot Ink
- Left Shift - Swim on the Painted Wall


:::
